summary: Synthetic MEDIUM vulnerability in pdos-vuln-fixture-fixed 1.0.0 with a published fix (test fixture).
details: Deterministic, hermetic OSV advisory used only by the pyforge-warden (Warden) test suite (Story 5.1) to prove fixed-version extraction from affected[].ranges[].events[] -- unlike PDOS-FIXTURE-0001/0002 (which use the simpler 'versions' enumeration form), this record affects the synthetic PyPI package `pdos-vuln-fixture-fixed` via an ECOSYSTEM range (introduced at the beginning, fixed at 2.0.0) -- the shape real-world PyPI advisories most commonly use. There is no such real package.
